_about: ChessQuest game template. Copy a block from 'templates', fill in the values, then append the object to scripted_games_data.json. Run the seed script afterward.

_field_guide.pattern: One of the 12 keys from PATTERN_SEQUENCE: fork | pin | back_rank_mate | skewer | discovered_attack | double_check | deflection | decoy | smothered_mate | overloading | x_ray_attack | zwischenzug
_field_guide.game_number: 1-5 for practice games. 6 for the main game of that pattern.
_field_guide.title: Short punchy title shown on the game card. Max ~5 words.
_field_guide.opening: Opening name shown to the student (e.g. 'Italian Game', 'Sicilian Najdorf'). Purely informational.
_field_guide.story: 1-2 sentence hook shown before the board. Describe what just happened and hint at the tactic without giving it away.
_field_guide.pgn: The scripted intro moves in standard PGN SAN notation ending with ' *'. Both sides play. Must be ≥15 half-moves (plies). The board pauses here for the student to find the pattern move.
_field_guide.setup_fen: Starting FEN. Always use the standard start position unless you have a specific reason. Copy the value from an existing game.
_field_guide.side: white or black — which side the STUDENT plays.
_field_guide.pattern_fen: [practice only] FEN of the board after all scripted moves. Copy it from a chess engine after replaying the PGN. This is what the validator uses.
_field_guide.best_move: [practice only] The canonical pattern move in UCI notation (e.g. 'd4d5', 'g4e3'). From-square then to-square, no spaces. Add a promotion piece for pawn promotions: 'e7e8q'.
_field_guide._main_game_extra: Main games (game_number=6) replace pattern_fen+best_move with these two fields:
_field_guide.target_patterns: [main only] Array of pattern keys the student can score during free play. Cumulative: level 3 includes fork, pin, back_rank_mate.
_field_guide.checkpoints: [main only] Array of {ply, pattern} objects. ply = half-move number (1=White's first move). Marks where the scripted tactic occurs for the verifier.
_rules: Each game must use a DIFFERENT opening from the other 5 games for the same pattern.
The student side must alternate W/B across the 5 practice games (aim for 3 white, 2 black or vice versa).
The pattern must genuinely occur — verify with python -m chess_pipeline.check_designs or check_line.py.
For practice games: after all scripted moves, the ONLY strong move should be the target pattern. Avoid positions where the student can win material a different way first.
story should mention WHAT happened (e.g. 'Black's queen wandered') not WHAT TO DO (don't say 'play Nxe4').

practice_game.story: One or two sentences that set the scene and hint at the tactic. Do not reveal the answer.

main_game.story: One or two sentences. The student plays the whole game; hint at the pattern they should watch for.
